opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme

amount.raw: Financial support for Cara, fee waivers and other support from partner universities; 2- or 3-year awards as standard

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics from any country in the world, on any continent, forced to flee by risk of imminent imprisonment, injury or death; open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or recently displaced, regardless of nationality; can support PhD or postdoctoral placements.
opportunities.summary: A rescue fellowship programme for academics in immediate danger, arranging temporary refuge at universities and research institutions (mostly in the UK) in a network of 135 institutions, helping them continue their research and teaching until they can return home.
